notes.subject: הצר הצרר
notes.rationale: Root צרר repeated: 'the adversary that oppresses' — the doubling intensifies, lost in Tok Pisin.

notes.subject: והרעתם בחצצרות
notes.rationale: Literal 'you shall break the ears with the trumpets' vs 'blow an alarm' — Tok Pisin takes the sound-blast sense.

notes.subject: ונזכרתם לפני יהוה
notes.rationale: Hebrew 'you shall be remembered before Yahwe' — passive; Tok Pisin renders 'not lost from the eye of Yahwe' to keep the being-noticed sense.

translation: Na sapos yupela i go long pait long kantri bilong yupela, long birua i bagarapim yupela, yupela i ken kilim singsing wantaim ol trumpet, na yupela bai i no lus long ai bilong Yahwe Elohim bilong yupela, na yupela bai i wokabaut fri na sef long ol birua bilong yupela.
